profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Imaging
profile.summary: I bring a robust background in designing scalable software architectures and combining them with fast-paced R&D topics like deep learning, robotics, and sensor processing.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Company acquired by EZContacts in 2026

Responsible for full software infrastructure and development of Veero’s core product lines: 
• Veero EyeSize: e-commerce SAAS product that provides customers accurate measurements for eyeglass frame and prescription fitting
• Veero Eyesize IRL: in store version of the Veero Eyesize solution. Designed for a streamlined customer and associate engagement and integration with pre-existing point-of-service systems
• Products compatible across iOS, Android, and desktop devices and across all major browsers.  

Co-researcher of patented technology to measure pupillary distance (PD), lens measures, and facial features with industry leading accuracy. 

Patents:
Monocular Visual-Inertial Alignment for Scaled
Distance Estimation on Mobile Devices
Filed on: August 24, 2020
U.S. Appl. No.: 17/001,120

Method and System for Measuring Coplanar
Point Distances Using an RGB-D Camera
Filed on: November 8, 2022
U.S. Appl. No.: 63/382,737

Monocular Camera-Assisted Technique with
Glasses Accommodation for Precise Facial
Feature Measurements at Varying Distances
Filed on: March 16, 2023
U.S. Appl. No.: 63/490,610

As-worn Frame Measurement System 
and Methods for Eyewear Fitting
Filed on: April 18, 2025
U.S. Appl. No.: 63/790,988
positions.insights: Skills: Deep Learning · GPGPU · Machine Learning · Software Architectural Design · Computer Vision · DevOps · Gitlab · Project Management · Startups · patents

positions.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer
positions.description:
Subject-matter expert/lead engineer for work on computer vision, AI, GPGPU, and deep learning

Example work includes: 
• Lead software architect for core computer vision workflow framework written in C++ and CUDA. A directed acyclic graph framework that helps the software team easily configure and combine complex computational computer vision pipelines while managing GPU and threading resources. 
• Person and obstacle mapping and avoidance system based on 360 view EO and IR camera system. Integrated into ROS and ROS2
• Physiological sensing system for AI based human injury detection (Pose detection, facial landmarks, and body segmentation)
• High speed segmentation, detection, and classification pipeline deployed on NVIDIA Jetson products
• Real-time deep learning based image denoising of 1080p video streams in maritime environments
• Real-time detection/tracking of small movers (<20 pixels) from high resolution (>= 4Kx4K) high altitude video. 
• Custom YOLOv8 pipeline able to process 6 HD video streams on the AGX ORIN at 30fps (effective rate: 180fps)
positions.insights: Skills: Deep Learning · GPGPU · Machine Learning · Software Architectural Design · Computer Vision · CUDA · C++ · Program Management · Optimization

positions.title: Research Engineer/Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
• Lead engineer for development of Java and C++ based autonomous underwater vehicle planning and control algorithms for oil platform inspection. 
• Developed real-time C/C++ sensor filtering and vehicle pose estimation algorithms for use in an autonomous mono-wing aircraft

positions.title: Member Engineering Staff
positions.description:
• Lead developer for JAVA based planning, alert, and threat classification algorithms to be used in a coordinated multi-ship planning tool
• Developed planning algorithms for AEGIS based ballistic missile defense
• Created algorithms for analyzing quality of AEGIS radar sensing based on meeting mission critical parameters
